reviews.text:
The Clio High Glow Cushion in Shade 04 Ginger introduces a new dimension to the world of cushion foundations, combining skincare benefits with a radiant finish. As a standout addition to Clio's beauty lineup, this cushion promises to deliver a healthy glow while providing buildable coverage and sun protection. In this comprehensive review, we'll delve into various aspects of the product, from its packaging to its performance on the skin.

Let's start with the packaging, where Clio consistently excels in marrying functionality with aesthetics. The High Glow Cushion comes in a compact, stylish case adorned with the brand's logo. The sleek design is not only visually appealing but also practical for on-the-go application. The cushion is housed securely, preventing any spillage or drying out of the product. The inclusion of a mirror in the lid is a thoughtful touch, making it convenient for quick touch-ups throughout the day.
reviews.zh:
Clio High Glow Cushion 嘅 04 Ginger 色號為氣墊粉底世界帶嚟咗新嘅層次，結合咗護膚功效同亮澤妝感。作為 Clio 化妝品系列入面嘅亮眼新成員，呢支氣墊承諾畀到健康嘅光澤感，同時做到可疊加嘅遮瑕度同防曬功能。喺呢篇詳盡嘅評價入面，我哋會從包裝到喺皮膚上嘅表現，深入探討產品嘅唔同方面。

先由包裝講起，Clio 一向都擅長將實用性同美學結合。High Glow Cushion 用咗一個細緻、型格嘅外殼，上面有品牌 logo。流線型設計唔止睇落吸引，仲好實用，方便帶出街補妝。氣墊固定得好穩陣，唔會漏或者乾。盒蓋內藏鏡子，呢個貼心嘅設計令全日補妝都更方便。

reviews.text: a very good cushion from clio however i do not recommend you buy this if you already have the mesh glow cushion! coverage is high with one push into tbe sponge but the same result can be achieved by building up tbe mesh glow. the package however is beautiful and the new sponge is very nice. attached is a photo i took wearing the cushion with no filter.
reviews.zh: 一支好好嘅 clio 氣墊，不過如果你已經有 mesh glow 氣墊，我唔推薦你買呢支！撳一下個海綿已經有高遮瑕度，但同一個效果其實可以透過疊加 mesh glow 嚟做到。包裝就好靚，新嘅海綿都好正。附上嘅相係我搽咗呢支氣墊冇 filter 嘅效果，

reviews.text: This cushions feels very silky and hydrating. It’s similar to the Clio mesh glow cushion, but offers a higher amount of coverage, but so keep in mind that it can slightly rub off if touched especially within a few minutes if application (but shouldn’t be a problem, as it can be easily retouched or blended out with the puff). This cushion really does make your skin look so glassy and glowy. The packing and scent is really nice and the freebie highlighter, puffs, and refill add a nice touch. I love it!
reviews.zh: 呢支氣墊嘅質感好絲滑而且好保濕。佢同 Clio mesh glow 氣墊相似，但遮瑕度更高，但要留意如果摸到佢，特別係上妝後幾分鐘內，可能會輕微甩色（不過唔係大問題，因為可以輕易用粉撲補返或者推開）。呢支氣墊真係令到你嘅皮膚望落好有玻璃肌水光感。包裝同香味都好正，仲有送嘅 highlighter、粉撲同補充裝，感覺好貼心。我鍾意！

reviews.text: Packaging is like an art piece. So stunning!! The glow cushion this year is a medium to medium high coverage and is builadable. It gives a watery transparent glow which is very different to the mesh glow (mesh glow is more moisturised glow with a heavier feel). It is very on trend with all the transparent glow (kind of like skincare infused makeup) type. The foundation in the bottle has more coverage, but the cushion in the same line gives a more glossy transparent glow. Highly recommend but please bring back the 05 Sand shade in the future.
reviews.zh: 包裝好似一件藝術品。超靚！！今年嘅 glow cushion 係中等至中高遮瑕，可以疊加。佢做到水潤透亮嘅光澤感，同 mesh glow 好唔同（mesh glow 係比較滋潤、感覺較厚嘅光澤）。好追得上而家透明光感呢個潮流（有啲似護膚注入化妝嗰種）。同一個系列嘅粉底液遮瑕度會高啲，但氣墊就畀到更水潤透亮嘅光澤感。非常推薦，但希望將來可以重新推出 05 Sand 呢個色號。

reviews.text: First of all, I think most of us were drawn to the beautiful packaging. This is definitely more glowy than the mesh glow cushion which I love. The shade 4 color seems slightly darker than the one for mesh glow. Coverage is still a good medium buildable. I powder it down so it doesn’t look oily. It’s okay for touch ups, doesn’t look too messy throughout the day. Idk if I like it more than mesh glow yet but it’s a nice cushion overall. Love that it came with highlighter, I love the prism highlighters, super buttery and blinding.
reviews.zh: 首先，我想大部分人都係被佢靚嘅包裝吸引住。佢比起 mesh glow cushion 更加有光澤感，我就好鍾意呢一點。4 號色望落比起 mesh glow 嗰個色號深少少。遮瑕度仍然係中等，可以疊加。我會用碎粉定妝，等佢唔會望落好油。補妝都仲可以，全日望落都唔會太凌亂。我都唔知我係咪鍾意佢多過 mesh glow，但整體嚟講係一支好嘅氣墊。好鍾意佢附送咗 highlighter，我鍾意 prism highlighters，超級 creamy 仲要好閃。

reviews.text: If you have the Clio Mesh Glow cushion, definitely give the new High Glow cushion a try! For one, not only the is the packaging gorgeous, the puff is a total upgrade. In my opinion, the old Mesh Glow puff was always very flimsy and collected dust easily, but the High Glow puff is much thicker and allows for more support and control. Both puffs have the pointed tip for hard to reach areas which is also a plus. More so the new High Glow sponge type foundation pan is a high point, the sponge is firm, and acts as an unmoving base to apply equal coverage to both puff and face. While compared to the Mesh Glow cushion, the mesh pan was super soft, and required disproportionate pressure to apply to the puff, not to mention how dust appeared so obviously in the mushier pan. The High Glow coverage and formula feels light to the touch, and barely budges when rested on the face. The main downside to the High Glow in my opinion is the lower SPF rating, but that’s expected with a dewier formula.
reviews.zh: 如果你有 Clio Mesh Glow 氣墊，一定要試吓新嘅 High Glow 氣墊！第一，包裝靚之餘，個粉扑亦係大升級。我個人覺得舊嘅 Mesh Glow 粉扑一向都好軟身，而且好易黏埋塵，High Glow 粉扑就厚好多，可以畀到更好嘅支撐力同控制力。兩個粉扑都有尖頭，方便處理難到位嘅地方，呢個亦係一個優點。而且新嘅 High Glow 海綿型粉芯係一大亮點，個海綿好實淨，可以做一個穩定嘅基礎，無論係粉扑定塊面都可以均勻上妝。相比起 Mesh Glow 氣墊嘅網面粉芯超軟身，要用唔平衡嘅力度先上到粉扑，更唔好講個軟淋淋嘅粉芯有幾明顯咁黐到塵。High Glow 嘅遮瑕度同配方觸感都好輕，搽上面之後好少移位。我個人覺得 High Glow 嘅主要缺點係 SPF 比較低，但係比較水潤嘅配方通常都係咁。

reviews.text: amazing coverage and super glowy!! i wore it for about 9 hours and it still looked great. i might like this more than the mesh glow cushion. though, i feel the shades run a tad darker than the other clio cushions, i should have stuck with “linen” (im 21n, sometimes a little deeper). compared to my new founwear cushion in shade ginger (which i got since i heard that line ran lighter), this is definitely darker. luckily, these blend out pretty seamlessly so it’s not that obvious.
reviews.zh: 遮瑕度超強，光澤感超勁！！我著咗大概 9 個鐘，妝容仲係好靚。我可能鍾意佢多過 mesh glow 氣墊。不過，我覺得色號比起其他 clio 氣墊深少少，我應該揀返 "linen"（我係 21n，有時會再深少少）。比起我新買嘅 founwear 氣墊嘅 ginger 色號（我買佢係因為聽講嗰個系列色號淺啲），呢支明顯深啲。幸運嘅係佢哋推開得好順，所以都唔係好明顯。

reviews.text: it’s hard to decide whether i like this high glow cushion or mesh glow cushion better. i think both come with both pros and cons. the high glow cushion has a more silicone-y puff compared to the rubycell puff of the mesh glow cushion, so i prefer the mesh glow cushion puff more. i think the high glow puff makes it hard to pick up product and blend out on the skin. the high glow cushion gives me a more glowy and youthful base compared to the mesh glow cushion. the high glow cushion sits better on my face and also doesn’t crease as much around my eyes and smile lines as much as the mesh glow cushion, but it blends super weirdly around my lips and theres kind of cakey around my lips which is not a problem i have with the mesh glow cushion (?). i do like how the high glow cushion comes with four puffs compared to the typical two puffs for any other cushion. overall i think my biggest complaint with the high glow cushion is the puff.
reviews.zh: 好難揀我係鍾意 high glow 氣墊定 mesh glow 氣墊多啲。我覺得兩支都有佢哋嘅優缺點。high glow 氣墊嘅粉扑比起 mesh glow 氣墊嘅 rubycell 粉扑更似 silicone 質地，所以我比較鍾意 mesh glow 氣墊嘅粉扑。我覺得 high glow 嘅粉扑令產品難以沾起，亦難以喺皮膚上推開。相比起 mesh glow 氣墊，high glow 氣墊畀到我更光澤、更青春嘅底妝。high glow 氣墊喺我塊面貼服過 mesh glow 氣墊，眼圈同笑紋附近都冇咁易卡粉，但係喺嘴邊附近推開得好怪，仲有少許厚粉感，呢個問題我用 mesh glow 氣墊就唔會出現（？）。我鍾意 high glow 氣墊會附送四個粉扑，比起其他氣墊一般只有兩個粉扑，呢個真係好正。整體嚟講，我對 high glow 氣墊最大嘅投訴係粉扑。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
